rationale: Third-party child was injured (broken wrist) due to icy condition on the policyholder's walkway during an ice storm; injury to a third party's person arising from premises condition is classic liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are anticipated to submit medical bills. Pediatric injury and property-condition liability require prompt adjuster contact.

case_facts.description: slip and fall on icy walkway; child broke wrist
